name: Terrarium 40x40x40
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 40x40x40 cm. Volume: 64.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: A cube with 40 cm sides: a 1600 cm² floor and 64 liters of volume. It has no 3D background, so the whole 40 cm depth is free. This is the first model in the series whose floor area suits a single adult leopard gecko, not just juveniles.

On a 40x40 cm floor a leopard or fat-tailed gecko has a warm hide in one corner, a cool one in the opposite corner and a humid one in between. The 40 cm height is more than ground geckos need, but it suits a crested gecko if you add branches and plants. A young corn snake uses both the floor and the branches, while an adult will need a terrarium about a meter long.

The square floor fits easily into a corner of a room or on a smaller dresser. If you keep a crested gecko, we can build the same base taller, for example 40x40x60. Film of your choice goes on three sides, and the build takes 7 to 14 days. We ship the 40 cm cube by courier throughout Serbia.
